title: Vazhve Mayam
desc: Rajasekaran, a pilot, develops feelings towards Devi, an air hostess. Even after her continued rejection and insults, he continues to persuade her.

title: Amman Kovil Vasalile
desc: Ponrasu, an honest man, is at loggerheads with Sethupathi, an evil man. Impressed by his good nature, Pongothai falls for Ponrasu, but things take an ugly turn when Sethupathi wants to marry her.

title: Kumaran Rajini Rasigan
desc: Bujji moves to Chennai after an argument with his childhood friend Chitti. He returns after 12 years to prove his love for her.

title: Puthu Manithan
desc: Kabali, a fisherman who is both revered and dreaded, falls for Suganthi, a chorus singer, and tries to woo her. When he is about to declare his love, she announces her marriage.

title: Arasu
desc: Thirunavukkarasu, a soft-spoken man, has two good-natured parents who are involved in the upliftment of society. However, when his parents are brutally assassinated, he seeks revenge for their deaths.
